column30: Integrate image perceptual hashing and metadata-based duplicate checks.
column55:
24/Oct/26 9:41 AM;712020:0d7aec1c-4c2f-46f1-b9d2-9a3757446339;h3. ✅ Ticket Completion & Verification Report

Implemented the two-layer deduplication engine in {{app/services/dedup.py}}:

* *Layer 1 (Visual)*: 64-bit DCT perceptual hash ({{pHash}}) computed from preprocessed grayscale image; flagged when Hamming distance <= 4.
* *Layer 2 (Textual)*: SHA-256 cryptographic hash of composite string {{merchant_slug | ISO_date | total_cents}}.
* *Database & API Integration*: Registered hashes stored in Supabase {{receipt_hashes}}. Re-uploaded receipts are immediately blocked prior to downstream OCR costs with an {{HTTP 409 Conflict}} payload containing the original receipt ID.
* *Empirical Validation*: 4 unit tests in {{cli_test.py}} passed (deterministic fingerprinting, distinct receipt handling, visual match rejection).

column55:
24/Oct/26 9:33 AM;712020:0d7aec1c-4c2f-46f1-b9d2-9a3757446339;h3. ✅ Ticket Completion & Verification Report

The dual-path image processing and text extraction pipeline is fully implemented and operational:

* *Preprocessing*: Built OpenCV pipeline with Laplacian variance blur detection (>80), deskewing, 4-point perspective warp, and CLAHE contrast equalization ({{app/services/preprocessor.py}}).
* *Dual-OCR Router*: Implemented classifier routing printed receipts to Google Cloud Vision API / Gemini 3.5 Flash (with Tesseract 5 fallback) and handwritten notes to EasyOCR ({{app/services/ocr_router.py}}).
* *Item Normalization*: Built Levenshtein fuzzy string matcher loaded with 139 local retail taxonomy items ({{app/services/normalizer.py}}), regex parsing for PKR currency, quantities, pack units, and spatial bounding box calculation.
* *Empirical Validation*: Tested on real sample receipts ({{printed_sample.jpg}} blur=2170.8, {{handwritten_sample.jpg}} blur=2517.0). All test suites in {{app.cli_test}} passed.
